pairs.why: B has more of the expected parts (cab, side rods, boiler bands, buffers) with thinner rods and flatter plates, while A is a chunkier, simpler toy-like block.
Both piers have similar posts, planks and rope coil, and I see no clear shape difference.
B has thicker, chunkier soles and fuller straps like the real pair, while A's soles are thinner and flatter.
A has believable boot proportions with a moderate shaft and a chunky heel, while B's shaft is stretched into a tall thin tube.
A has the tall tapered glass, thick base and long straw of the real card, while B is shorter and squatter with a short straw.
A keeps small earbuds and a thin cord like the real card, while B has bulbous oversized earbuds and a thickened cord.
A has the tall chunky foot pockets and flared blades of the real fins, though its blades are a bit short; B's pockets are low and its blades run parallel.
A has a thinner shelf, a flatter lintel and thin easel legs, while B has a puffy rounded shelf edge, a stronger arch and a fatter target disc.
